description: Council member's vote on a proposal. Transmitted as the plaintext body of an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record so vote privacy holds at the substrate layer (only council members with the read-cap can tally). Per ADR-2605181100 + uhl-right-neural council pattern.

proposalUri.description: AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record carrying the proposal.

rationale.description: Optional explanation. Visible only to other council members with the read-cap.
